## Terminology

- MUST, SHOULD and MAY describe obligations.

## Requirement identifiers

### Retired requirement identifiers

- `IG0003`: Replaced by `IG0007`.

## Validation<a id="validation"></a>

- A release MUST validate its inputs.
  `IG0001`<a id="ig0001"></a>
- A release SHOULD record its result. `IG0007`<a id="ig0007"></a>

**You MUST:**

- Keep the record. `IG0004`<a id="ig0004"></a>
- Make the record available. `IG0005`<a id="ig0005"></a>

### Optional checks<a id="optional-checks"></a>

- A maintainer MAY run additional checks. `IG0006`<a id="ig0006"></a>

### Reasoning

These explanations MAY quote keywords without adding requirements.
